# AliasFunctionsUsage

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `AliasFunctionsUsageInspection`

Several built-in PHP functions exist only as alternative names for another
built-in (`sizeof` for `count`, `join` for `implode`, …), and a few of those
alternative names were deprecated or removed. Calling the canonical function
keeps code consistent and avoids relying on legacy names.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6} [Before]
<?php
$total = sizeof($rows);
$csv   = \join(';', $cells);
$ok    = is_long($port) && is_writeable($dir);
magic_quotes_runtime(0);
$n = SizeOf($rows);
$s = $builder->join(',');  // E3
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$total = count($rows);
$csv   = \implode(';', $cells);
$ok    = is_int($port) && is_writable($dir);
magic_quotes_runtime(0);
$n = count($rows);
$s = $builder->join(',');  // E3
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Use &#39;count(...)&#39; instead of the alias &#39;sizeof(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;implode(...)&#39; instead of the alias &#39;join(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;is_int(...)&#39; instead of the alias &#39;is_long(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;is_writable(...)&#39; instead of the alias &#39;is_writeable(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: &#39;magic_quotes_runtime(...)&#39; is a legacy alias (deprecated 5.3, removed 7.0); stop relying on it.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;count(...)&#39; instead of the alias &#39;SizeOf(...)&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "AliasFunctionsUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore AliasFunctionsUsage

/**
 * @noinspection AliasFunctionsUsageInspection
 */
```
